customManagers.description: The pnpm the image installs; grouped with package.json's packageManager pin, which CI uses

packageRules.description: engines.node is the kit's Node floor, not a pin
@types/node follows the Node major, which is a manual change (esbuild target, node-toolchain.test.ts)
.node-version and the Dockerfile's Node images must match (node-toolchain.test.ts), so they move in one PR
CI's pnpm (packageManager) and the image's pnpm (Dockerfile) move in one PR
The kit's npm version and its reusable-workflow SHAs move in one PR (kit-pins.test.ts); a fix(deps) commit releases a patch. Kit ADR-0005, security fixes §4
Kit patches and minors automerge once the required checks pass; majors and moved tags (digest) wait for review
